info.title: Ingestion Service
info.description: Ingest call data from CSV uploads, scheduled API polling, and event streams

post.description: Accepts a CSV file with call records and bulk-inserts them into call_master. Existing call_ids are silently skipped (idempotent).

400.description: The `detail` field tells you exactly what is wrong: 'Missing Content-Type header; expected text/csv.', 'Unsupported file type: {actual_type}. Expected text/csv.', or 'Uploaded file is empty'.

413.description: File exceeds upload size limit. Split into smaller batches.

422.description: The `detail` field names the exact problem: 'CSV file is empty or has no header row', 'CSV missing required columns: call_id' (lists each missing column), or 'Too many parsing errors' (>50% of rows failed).

503.description: Database unavailable — retry after a short delay.

post.description: Fetches rows from the configured Redash queries and upserts them into seller_profile, seller_gst, and seller_hotlead. Pass `tables` to restrict which tables are synced (default: all three).

502.description: Could not reach Redash — check REDASH_BASE_URL and REDASH_API_KEY.

503.description: Database unavailable — retry after a short delay.

post.description: Triggers the full Redash → DB pipeline and upserts results into the database. Designed to be called by Cloud Scheduler daily. Eight steps in order: call_master, seller_profile, seller_gst, seller_hotlead, seller_blni (per-event rejections + narrow upsert of blni_count_* on seller_engagement for every seller in seller_profile), seller_engagement (merged Redash + HTTP sources, scoped to today's callees only — not every known seller; BLNI aggregates are NOT included, they are written in step 4.5 via a separate narrow upsert), seller_profile_extras, call_master_outcomes. On partial failure, completed_steps lists what succeeded and failed_step / failure_error indicate where it stopped.

503.description: Redash query IDs not configured or database unavailable.

post.summary: Refresh BLNI for every seller in seller_profile
post.description: One-shot refresh of the BLNI table (plus blni_count_* on seller_engagement) for every GLID in seller_profile. Uses the same parameterised Redash query as daily sync step 4.5 and the same narrow engagement upsert, so it's safe to run at any time — it only adds missing per-event rows (insert-skip-duplicate) and refreshes the aggregate counts. Typical runtime for 5k sellers: ~30s (5 batches of 1000 @ ~5s each).

get.description:
Full seller composite (profile + gst + engagement).

The staleness check runs on every request — a warm-but-stale non-callee
is silently refreshed before ``load_seller_detail`` runs, so callers
always get data that is at most ``seller_staleness_ttl_hours`` old
(default 24h). This mirrors the same contract as the sub-resource
endpoints (``/calls``, ``/hotleads``, etc.).

On a DB miss, ``maybe_warm_seller`` performs the upstream fan-out (via
the implicit staleness path — a missing row is treated as stale). Returns
404 only if upstream also has no profile row for the GLID. Returns 503
if the backfill doesn't complete within the configured timeout.

Optional ``?backfill=true`` warms the seller only on a cold miss;
``?refresh=true`` forces an upstream re-fetch unconditionally. See the
sub-resource endpoint docs for full semantics.

get.description:
List calls for a seller within an optional date range.

Returns 404 if the seller is unknown (no `seller_profile` row). An empty
200 response means the seller exists but has no calls in the window.

Optional ``?backfill=true`` warms the seller (full upstream fan-out)
if its profile is missing — useful for first-time access where the DB
hasn't yet been populated. ``?refresh=true`` forces an upstream
re-fetch unconditionally (use sparingly; 5-15s + clobbers daily-sync
aggregates).

get.description:
List buylead-not-interested (BLNI) events for a seller with reason + comment.

Each row carries the full reject context — reason code, human-readable
reason text, free-form reseller comment, and the mcat/offer IDs. Filter
by date range and/or reason_code.

No dependency on seller_profile existence — BLNI is a global IndiaMart
signal, not scoped to our bot-called sellers. Unknown gluser_ids return
an empty page (total=0) rather than 404.

Optional ``?backfill=true`` / ``?refresh=true`` — see ``/calls``.

get.description:
Seller's 30-day CSL activity events (from ``seller_engagement``).

Reads the ``activity_events_30d`` JSONB blob populated by the daily sync
and the /sellers/{id} cold-miss backfill. Each event carries bizfeed
fields like ``datevalue``, ``fk_activity_id``, ``fk_display_title``,
``modid``, ``request_url``.

Returns 404 if no ``seller_engagement`` row exists for the GLID. A 200
with ``event_count=0`` means the seller has no activity in the window.
``updated_at`` reflects the engagement row's last refresh — callers can
use it to decide whether to wait for the next daily sync.

Optional ``?backfill=true`` / ``?refresh=true`` — see ``/calls``.

get.description:
Point-in-time engagement metrics at a caller-supplied reference date.

The daily sync overwrites ``seller_engagement`` with today's rolling
values, so past-date lookups aren't possible from that table. This
endpoint computes them on demand by firing 9 parameterised Redash
queries in parallel (enq_received, enq_replies, callback, pns,
call_stats, NI/NP/WN, meetings, hot_meetings, products_modified)
and reading BLNI counts from the local ``seller_blni`` table. No
snapshots are stored.

Behaviour:
- No seller_profile dependency — works for any gluser_id. Sellers
  with no activity return fields=None (JSON null); the endpoint
  never coalesces missing values to 0.
- Partial failures don't 500: if one source fails (Redash timeout,
  bad JSON), that source's fields stay None and ``failed_sources``
  lists its name.
- Latency: ~3-5s on a cache miss (dominated by slowest Redash call);
  sub-10ms on a cache hit. Results are cached per ``(gluser_id, as_of)``
  for ``ENGAGEMENT_METRICS_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS`` (default 1h, in-process)
  so a burst of eval-agent calls on the same seller / same day shares
  one upstream fetch.

Constraints:
- ``as_of`` must be on or before today.
- ``as_of`` should be within the last 2 years; beyond that, Redash
  source data may not fully cover the 1yr window.

Seller "Category-City Report" — the seller's MCAT × City buy-lead matrix.

Ports ``Categories.getAllData`` from the legacy
``company/Category_CityDetails.aspx`` page (Redash query 2500, data
source 16). Thin Redash wrapper, no DB storage — the query gives the
seller's last 6 months of *business* buy-lead purchases, aggregated by
MCAT × buy-lead city, with the marketplace-wide "BL Approved" count, the
seller's "BL Consumed" count, trade-alert rank, mapped product count and
mapped premium service. Capped at 200 rows ordered by BL Consumed desc,
then trade-alert rank asc, then preferred-city desc.

Behaviour:
- No seller_profile dependency — works for any gluser_id. A seller with
  no qualifying purchases returns ``row_count: 0``.
- Optional ``mcat_id`` / ``city_id`` narrow the report (echoed back on
  the response). They map to the upstream query's optional filters.
- ``limit`` (1..200, default 200) trims the response to the top N rows;
  the upstream query/cache still cover the full ≤200, so varying
  ``limit`` is a free slice of the same cached result.
- Results are cached on Redash per ``(gluser_id, mcat_id, city_id)`` for
  ``REDASH_CATEGORY_CITY_CACHE_SECONDS`` (default 30 min). First/cold
  call: a few seconds for most sellers, up to ~30-40s for sellers in
  very popular categories (the query counts marketplace offers across
  all their categories); cached hits return immediately.

Errors:
- ``501`` if the Redash query id isn't configured
  (``REDASH_QUERY_CATEGORY_CITY`` unset).
- ``502`` if the upstream Redash call fails or times out.

schema.description: Return only the top N rows (by BL Consumed).

SellerActivityOut.title: SellerActivityOut
SellerActivityOut.description:
CSL activity events (last 30 days) for a seller.

``events`` is the raw list returned by the bizfeed GladminActivity API,
deduped across paginated pages. Populated at most once per daily sync
or /sellers/{id} cold-miss backfill and stored as JSONB on
``seller_engagement.activity_events_30d``. ``updated_at`` is the
engagement row's last refresh timestamp — use it to judge freshness.

SellerBlniOut.title: SellerBlniOut
SellerBlniOut.description: One buylead-not-interested rejection event with full reject context.

SellerBulkResponse.title: SellerBulkResponse
SellerBulkResponse.description:
Bulk lookup response.

`items` contains one entry per gluser_id that has a seller_profile row.
`not_found_ids` lists any IDs the caller passed that had no profile row,
so callers can distinguish "record missing" from "fields unpopulated".

SellerCategoryCityReportOut.title: SellerCategoryCityReportOut
SellerCategoryCityReportOut.description:
Seller "Category-City Report" — the MCAT × City buy-lead matrix.

Thin Redash wrapper (no DB storage): the upstream query (Redash 2500,
ports ``Categories.getAllData`` from ``company/Category_CityDetails.aspx.vb``)
covers the seller's last 6 months of *business* buy-lead purchases,
aggregated by MCAT × buy-lead city, capped at 200 rows ordered by BL
Consumed desc, then trade-alert rank asc, then preferred-city desc.
Results are Redash-cached per ``(gluser_id, mcat_id, city_id)`` for a
short TTL (``REDASH_CATEGORY_CITY_CACHE_SECONDS``, default 30 min).

``mcat_id`` / ``city_id`` echo the optional filters that were applied
(``None`` when unfiltered); ``limit`` echoes the requested cap.
``row_count`` is the number of rows actually returned (``<= limit``).

SellerCategoryCityRow.title: SellerCategoryCityRow
SellerCategoryCityRow.description:
One row of the seller's MCAT × City buy-lead matrix (last 6 months).

Mirrors a row of the live "Category-City Report" grid on
``company/Category_CityDetails.aspx``: Category Name, City Name,
BL Approved (6M), BL Consumed (6M), Category Rank, Product Count,
Services Mapped — plus the MCAT / city ids so the ``?mcat_id=`` /
``?city_id=`` filters are usable.

SellerDetailOut.title: SellerDetailOut
SellerDetailOut.description: Full seller composite — profile + gst + engagement as sections.

SellerMetricsAtDateOut.title: SellerMetricsAtDateOut
SellerMetricsAtDateOut.description:
Point-in-time 90d / 1yr engagement metrics computed at `as_of`.

Each field is independently nullable so that a failure in any single
upstream source (e.g. one of the Redash queries timing out) only NULLs
the affected fields rather than failing the whole endpoint.
``failed_sources`` names any source that didn't contribute.
